stories.title: police HGV cab catches drivers on their phones on the A55
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped more than 30 vehicles on the A55, A483 and A494 earlier this month as part of Operation Tramline. The force’s Roads Crime Unit issued tickets and graduated fixed penalty notices for a range of road safety offences. Officers detected drivers using mobile phones behind the wheel, failing to wear a seatbelt

stories.title: Senedd: Reform MS accuses health minister of lying during debate over health visitors pay
stories.summary: A Reform Senedd Member has accused the health minister of lying during a debate on the health visitor pay dispute. James Evans, who is shadow minister for health and prevention, hit out at Mabon ap Gwynfor on Wednesday 16 September. The interaction came in a debate on the pay dispute at Cwm Taf Morgannwg University

stories.title: Welsh NHS waiting lists rise again as minister pledges planned care ‘reset’
stories.summary: The health minister has pledged to reset how “planned care is delivered” after NHS waiting lists rose for the fourth month in a row. Provisional data released today shows that in July there were just under 709,700 referral to treatment (RTT) patient pathways waiting to start treatment – an increase of around 11,300 since June.

stories.title: Fire service warns of rise in lithium battery fires across North Wales
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service has warned of an increase in fires involving lithium-ion batteries in recent weeks. stories.title: New office building and pilot health clinic approved at Hawarden Airport
